user.title: Smart Comfort
user.description: Fewer, smarter comfort alerts, and control of your air conditioners, fans and purifiers. Add the rooms afterwards in the options, or configure everything in YAML.

data_description.notify: Where the alerts go (notify.mobile_app_…, a notify group…).
data_description.outdoor_temperature: One or more outdoor sensors; unavailable ones are ignored.
data_description.outdoor_aggregate: Minimum avoids a sensor in the sun.

error.invalid_options: Some values are invalid, check them.

init.title: Smart Comfort options
init.description: {rooms} room(s) configured. If you use YAML, changing it replaces these options at the next restart.

data_description.notify: Where the alerts go (notify.mobile_app_…, a notify group…).
data_description.outdoor_temperature: Outdoor sensors outside the outdoor places (weather entity, sensor in no area); unavailable ones are ignored.
data_description.outdoor_aggregate: Minimum avoids a sensor in the sun.
data_description.outdoor_noise: Sound level sensors outside (dB), added to those of the outdoor places: no suggestion to open the windows while it's noisy, and an alert when windows are open in the noise.
data_description.outdoor_air_quality: Air quality index sensors outside or in the city (Atmo France, AQI…), added to those of the outdoor places: no suggestion to open the windows while the air is poor, and an alert when windows are open then. The worst one counts.
data_description.digest_window: Minutes to wait for other alerts before sending one grouped notification. Critical alerts don't wait.
data_description.reminder: Minutes after which a problem still going on is notified again. 0: never (only when it gets worse).
data_description.snooze_duration: Minutes of the notification's Snooze button and of the snooze action by default.
data_description.startup_grace: Minutes after Home Assistant starts during which nothing is sent.
data_description.quiet_start: From then until the end, only critical alerts are sent; the others go out at the end if still relevant.
data_description.presence: Zone, person, group or boolean: while nobody is home, only critical alerts are sent.
data_description.clear_when_resolved: Remove the notification from the phones once every notified problem is over.
data_description.url: Opened when the notification is tapped, e.g. homeassistant://navigate/lovelace/comfort
data_description.tag: Each notification replaces the previous one with this tag instead of piling up.

alerts.title: Alerts
alerts.description: Settings of an alert for every room. A room can override the too hot / too cold thresholds in its form, and everything in YAML.

data_description.threshold: Too hot/cold, CO₂, humidity: the value. Open/close the windows: the indoor/outdoor difference.
data_description.min_indoor: Suggest opening only when the room is at least this warm.
data_description.min_outdoor: Only when it is at least this hot outside.
data_description.max_outdoor: Only when it is this cold or colder outside.
data_description.max_outdoor_noise: Not suggested while the outdoor noise is above this (needs an outdoor noise sensor).
data_description.max_outdoor_air: Not suggested while the outdoor air quality is worse than this level, from 1 (good) to 6 (extremely poor).
data_description.hysteresis: The problem ends only once the value is back past the threshold by this much: no flapping.
data_description.delay: Minutes the condition must hold before it is a problem.
data_description.escalation: Notify again when the value gets this much worse than when last notified. 0: never.

data_description.start: Fans and purifiers go to full speed when an opening opens only between these times. Both empty: all day.
data_description.manual_override: Minutes a device changed by hand is left alone. 0: never paused.
data_description.suppress_when_handled: No “too hot” alert for a room whose air conditioner or fan Smart Comfort has turned on.
data_description.night_start: Between these times the devices use their night settings (quieter speed, preset or fan mode) and there is no window boost for them.
